title: Adaptive fine-tuning based transfer learning for the identification of MGMT promoter methylation status
summary: Transfer learning on MRI-derived features predicts MGMT promoter methylation status in glioblastoma, a specific molecular-diagnostic result. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
organization: University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center

evidence.tested: Transfer learning on MRI-derived features predicts MGMT promoter methylation status in glioblastoma, a specific molecular-diagnostic result.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
evidence.ai_role: UPENN-GBM and additional cohorts are used to compare transferred and non-transferred models against molecular methylation labels with ROC/AUC performance.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
